topics.description: The FBI's search of the Fulton County election office in Georgia is part of a broader effort to investigate potential voter data fraud claims. This trend is significant because it highlights the ongoing scrutiny of election processes and the potential for fraud in the United States.
topics.reason: The FBI's actions are linked to Trump's efforts to relitigate the 2020 election.

topics.description: The shooting of Alex Pretti by Border Patrol agents in Minneapolis has sparked growing criticism and calls for an investigation. The FBI is also investigating Rep. Ilhan Omar being sprayed with a substance at a Minneapolis town hall.
topics.reason: The incidents have raised concerns about police and federal agency actions in Minneapolis.
